run_preprocess_index_data: run the preprocess module to index a text file into a binary torch tensor using a vocabulary file
create_dictionary_read_vocab: create a Dictionary object by reading a vocabulary file with word-frequency pairs
build_dictionary_index_data: build indexed sentence tensors from a text file using a Dictionary and save to a binary path
test_dictionary_index_word: test the Dictionary index method to map a word string to its integer ID
refactor_dictionary_prune_vocab: refactor the Dictionary prune method to limit the vocabulary size to a maximum number of entries
